scripts.predev: if command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run wasm:build; fi
scripts.wasm:build: wasm-pack build crates/payroll-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../src/wasm/pkg --release --no-typescript && rm -f src/wasm/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.test:rust: if command -v cargo-nextest >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo nextest run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; else cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; fi
